crew-tools.about: The crew's measuring tools (reference install, 2026-09-30..10-03): crew-frontier.py (which tools a worker should carry: hot sent, cold behind Tool Search), crew-prefix-ab-postcheck.py (the prefix-cache A/B's post-restart check), crew-salad-fix-install.sh with the crew engine's two drop-ins under engines/crew.service.d (prefix caching + MTP off), prompt-weight.py + prompt_weight.py (prompt chars per part and tokens per turn), hands-step-cap.py + hands-kit-backtest.py (the front door's step cap re-measure), crissa-claim-check.py (her claims against the tool replies).
